split_rules.development: All previously inspected Ey15-2, Macadamia, YSD56, Col-CEN and other observed datasets remain development or public positive controls; tuning permitted only here.
split_rules.validation: New donor/species/family homology groups can test a frozen candidate once; findings may trigger a new development iteration, but that validation set cannot become final-heldout.
split_rules.final-heldout: At least two previously unused plant species, donor groups and homolog groups sealed before model and baseline selection; one planned reveal after source, truth, denominator, power and commands are frozen.
split_rules.leakage: All reads, libraries, samples, accessions, haplotypes, assembly versions, edited descendants, nested subsets and homologous family variants of a donor or assembly lineage remain in one split. Identical resolved file paths or SHA-256 content across splits are rejected even if metadata is renamed. No random array/read split across a lineage.
split_rules.public_control: Published human/Col-CEN examples used for method choice are development positive controls, not plant final-heldout.

input_gate: T7 stable bounded write-readback before large acquisition or compute
eligibility_rule: Only a declared non-integrity benchmark task with all required role-tagged, structurally validated files and verified source provenance plus evidence can be eligible. Read+assembly tasks additionally require verified same-source donor/haplotype pairing plus evidence. Otherwise retain source-unresolved or pending; evidence statements require human review and are not inferred from SHA alone.

truth_hierarchy.edited-delta: exact injected assembly difference only; not physical biological copy truth
truth_hierarchy.physical: independent molecule or validated assay sufficient for biological abundance
truth_hierarchy.assembly-proxy: reference representation only; never absolute copy truth

preregistration_required_before_reveal: primary endpoint and denominator including zeros/absent arrays
independent donor/species cluster count and power

endpoint_rules.abundance: Report paired positive-family log2 error, MARE and bias; zero-family false attribution separately; reject/unknown retained in denominator. Diagnostic, assigned and physical bp remain distinct.
endpoint_rules.collapse: Binary classification and continuous injected missing-bp magnitude scored separately; all-zero and complete-deletion cases remain in denominator.
endpoint_rules.structure: HOR order/copy truth only for methods with that output; same assembly and same prior information for direct CENdetectHOR comparison.
endpoint_rules.resources: Full dependency pipeline and preparation costs; same host/input/budget; at least three isolated repeats except preregistered whole-genome feasibility single run.

assembly-structure: TandemX where same assembly and priors available
